test_objective: Check that an HTTP error response of type BadRequestData is raised if the Content-Type header is "application/ld+json" and the request payload body does not contain a @context term

test_cases.name: 001_08_01 Create one entity not containing a JSON-LD @context with a JSON-LD content type
test_cases.doc: Check that an HTTP error response of type BadRequestData is raised if the Content-Type header is "application/ld+json" and the request payload body does not contain a @context term
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/'
        method set to 'POST'
        Request Header['Content-Type'] set to 'application/ld+json' and
 payload defined in file: 'building-simple-attributes-sample.json'
}
